logic.entry: From dataset day0 completed closes, seed average gain/loss with simple means of firstL close changes (first score at dayL). Thereafter avg_t=((L-1)*avg_previous+new_gain_or_loss)/L, Decimal28. RSI=100*avg_gain/(avg_gain+avg_loss); when both zero use50. No reset at OOS/fold boundaries. SMA200 includes the current completed signal close. While flat, enter iff RSI<entry_rsi and completed signal close>SMA(trend_sma_days), both strict.
logic.exit: While long, exit iff RSI>=exit_rsi=50 or completed signal close<=SMA(trend_sma_days). Exit precedence; no same-decision re-entry or predictive labels.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)

sources.scope: Primary Wilder gain/loss initialization and recursive smoothing definition. Independently implemented Decimal math; neutral50 when gain+loss=0 is our explicit convention rather than TA-Lib zero.
